=Library dependences.=

If you want to use odiem whith boundled jndi sun stack, you don't need other libraries.

== Unboundid stack ==

Add *unboundid-ldapsdk-se.jar* to your classpath

== Apache stack ==

Add following libraries to your classpath:

  * *jcl-over-slf4j-1.5.10.jar*
  * *ldap-client-api-0.1.jar*
  * *log4j.jar*
  * *shared-all-0.9.18.jar*
  * *slf4j-api-1.5.10.jar*
  * *slf4j-log4j12-1.5.10.jar*

== Novel stack ==

Add following libraries to your classpath:

  * *ldap.jar*
  * *utilities.jar*


== Advanced featured ==

If you want to search on a bean marked as abstract you have to add to your classpath

  * *javassist.jar*
  * *scannotation-1.0.2.jar*
